tokens.name: shadow/2
tokens.label: shadow 2
tokens.description: Use for resting elevation on a filled control, such as a selected checkbox or toggle. Not: floating panels; it flattens on hover.

tokens.name: shadow/6
tokens.label: shadow 6
tokens.description: Use for a floating panel. Popovers, dropdowns, and menus. Not: a resting control.

tokens.name: shadow/8
tokens.label: shadow 8
tokens.description: Use for the next depth above a floating panel. Not: a menu plate, and not the deepest overlay.

tokens.name: shadow/16
tokens.label: shadow 16
tokens.description: Use for a deep overlay lifted well off the page. Not: dropdowns or resting controls.

tokens.name: shadow/24
tokens.label: shadow 24
tokens.description: Use for the deepest elevation on the scale. Not: menus, popovers, or inline controls.
